name: Handle With Care
summary: Curgle Cranklehop sends a crate of eggs to a druid in Rut'theran. The village lies in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Crate of Eggs
sections.body: Curgle Cranklehop entrusts you with a carefully packed crate for Erelas Ambersky. Hippogryph eggs lie inside, bound for the druid.

sections.title: The Druid of Rut'theran
sections.body: Erelas Ambersky cares for hippogryph eggs in Rut'theran Village. He helps them hatch and trains the young hippogryphs. Rut'theran is a small village in southern Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is inside the crate from Curgle Cranklehop?
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop's carefully packed crate holds hippogryph eggs.

faq.q: Where does the crate need to go?
aliases: where do i take the crate
faq.answer: Carry the crate to Erelas Ambersky, a druid in Rut'theran, a small village in Teldrassil.
Erelas Ambersky is a druid in Rut'theran Village. He cares for hippogryph eggs and trains the young hippogryphs after they hatch.
